observer: host Linux page_idle via KVM MMU notifier
identity: VM instance plus captured KVM guest-physical region and offset; never host PFN alone
boundary_policy: retain scan begin/end, mark intervals crossing semantic boundaries ambiguous; never exact attribution
huge_page_policy: report complete observed folio groups; never infer 4 KiB hits from a group hit
whole_sandbox_gate: all target cases, kernel/file-cache exercise, mapping stability, coverage and on/off overhead at both cadences must pass; missing evidence fails admission
fallback: guest process virtual-page referenced status via /proc/PID/clear_refs and smaps is aggregate only and cannot produce A_k; do not fabricate a page-set fallback. Inspect guest page_idle availability once; absent or inadequate capability is a stop.
failure_action: retain diagnostics, label whole-sandbox H1/H2 untested or inconclusive, stop before paid pilot
